answer_1.quote: Text summarization stands out as an important task in natural language processing, aiming to generate a condensed summary of a provided text while retaining its essential information.

answer_2.quote: We compare FineSurE with five similarity-based methods, ROUGE-1/-2/-L, BERTScore, and BARTScore; a NLI-based method, SummaC-Conv; two QA-based methods, UniEval and [QAFactEval]; and the latest LLM-based method, G-Eval.

answer_3.quote: We employ LLMs as a tool to conduct fact checking and keyfact alignment tasks.

answer_4.quote: FRANK ... providing fine-grained annotations of sentence-level factuality error types. ... REALSumm ... includes a list of human keyfacts, along with corresponding annotations indicating their presence in the summary.
answer_4.guideline: Annotations of factuality error types for FRANK and keyfact presence for REALSumm.
